messages.author: 32d9070bf205b3d5
messages.subject: working group & google earth engine presentation 12/5, 11am
parts:
Hello D-RUG!

We will have a working group on Thursday, 12/5 from 11am-1pm in 360 Shields Library (DataLab classroom). During the first hour, Amy Collins will give a presentation on using Google Earth Engine. We will provide a link for remote attendance as a reply to this email around 11am on Thursday. The recording will also be available on the D-RUG website in the future.

If you would like to follow along with the presentation, please sign up to GEE beforehand at this link. Scroll to the bottom of the page and click Sign Up Now. It takes a couple of days to approve you as a user, so make sure to do this ~now!

For those of you who don't sign up in time (i.e. if you're reading this email on Thursday), please still come along! You might not be able to use GEE on your own computer, but I'll be giving a quick intro to GEE first, and I'll have my code up on the big screen.

This will be our last D-RUG meeting of the quarter.

Best,
Taylor

--
Taylor Reiter
PhD Candidate
Food Science Graduate Group
Lab for Data Intensive Biology
University of California, Davis
